<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Advisory Engagement Timelines</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues. However, each of you agreed that a standard cutoff time was acceptable for UK corporate advisory engagements, particularly those involving cross-border transactions.

The best option will be to agree to cutoff at 4pm each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many new instructions were received after 4pm London time. We had three UK Corporate deals, and two EU Advisory mandates). After 4pm, the case management system would automatically roll new Corporate Advisory deals to the next day. However, for those deals that do not bridge after 4pm, the various compliance groups would need to remember that these deals are the following day's business. I am not sure how the procedures in LexisNexis InterAction would need to be modified for the fee-earner's pipeline reports, as the official books would not include these late instructions. Can LexisNexis InterAction run supplemental reports to ensure that the practice groups have accurate caseload positions each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a cutoff of 4pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle
x36557

Eric - any potential problems with the Daily Position Report?
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
</body>
